notes: CANONICAL for Gustava Samuelsdotter (b. 11 May 1842, Hjälmvik Nolgården, Stala / d. 28 Jul 1912, North Easton, Bristol, MA), daughter of Samuel Jacobsson & Sofia Nilsdotter, wife of Sven Johan Samuelsson. DUPLICATE exists as I182292318217 - same dates/places but unsourced and lists only one child (Simon Swanson). This record additionally carries daughter Selma Swanson (I182195860595, b. 1872 Gustorp, Stala / d. 1927 Easton MA), not present on the duplicate. Kept as primary.

Her birth/death years (1842-1912) are independently corroborated by a secondary compiled genealogy (yourroots.com) already cited in docs/research/ancestors/gen05-simon-swanson-anna-josephina-svenson.md, which gives 'Gustafva Samuelsdotter (1842-1912)' as Simon Swanson's mother - matching this record exactly.

Her son Simon Swanson also exists twice: I182197442974 (parented under the duplicate pair I182292318217/I182197443214, but itself the far better individually-sourced record - real MA vital/marriage records, 1900 census, Swedish Lutheran church records, Geneanet) vs. I182195860381 ('Simon A Swanson', parented under this canonical record, but only generically sourced to 'Ancestry Family Trees'). Recommend I182197442974 as the eventual canonical Simon Swanson record once his parents are re-pointed to this record and to the canonical Sven Johan Samuelsson (I182195860593, per the parallel gen-7 duplicate-person entry already in direct-line-issues.md). Not yet added to the tracker as its own duplicate-person pair - flagged in docs/research/ancestors/gen07-samuel-jacobsson.md.
